source.title: Design of 3D engineered protein hydrogels for tailored control of neurite growth

material: ELP-RGD hydrogel, 3.0 wt%, THPC 2:1 reactive site ratio (E = 2.1 kPa)

formulation.evidence: resulting in a final amorphous scaffold of 3.0 wt% (Figure 1C)
the concentration of THPC was adjusted to achieve reactive site ratios of 0.5:1, 1:1, and 2:1, using THPC solutions of 1.32, 2.64, and 5.28 mg/mL, respectively.

youngs_modulus.evidence: from 0.5:1 to 1:1 to 2:1 increased the initial elastic modulus of the resulting amorphous hydrogel (E = 0.5, 1.5, and 2.1 kPa, respectively, Figure 2A)

biology.cell_type: E9 chick dorsal root ganglion explants

viability_percent.evidence: In all cases, viability of stained cells was greater than 79% (Figure 2D)

other_outcomes.evidence: After 7 days, total neurite outgrowth was limited to 67,000 μm in the stiffest hydrogel
other_outcomes.name: total neurite outgrowth

survival.evidence: In all cases, viability of stained cells was greater than 79% (Figure 2D)

notes: RGD density 1.9 × 10^7 ligands/μm3. Modulus by unconfined compression in PBS at 37 °C.
